pr.title: MS7-MIG-I01: React foundation без изменения дизайна
pr.body:
## Goal / task

Refs #40 — MS7-MIG-I01, owner `13baybars`.

React foundation переносит shell и утверждённые UI states в отдельный frontend, сохраняя CSS и дизайн принятого Django baseline. PR остаётся на независимом review; **I01 не объявляется принятой или завершённой**.

## Commits / provenance

- Base: `ms7-mig-react-fastapi`; head branch: `ms7-mig-i01-foundation`.
- Исходная реализация: `c54a98b91195458b22a14aa4a6cbf14c7fe57e28`.
- Первоначальная публикация и docs-only SHA binding: `79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61`.
- Исправления B1/B2 и **текущий exact candidate HEAD: `150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55`**.
- Accepted integration input / parent исходной реализации: `8d958aeeb17da46839722441425ccbb5889e2ab7`.
- MIG_BASE_SHA, только provenance: `60b341fbd00f4c8dadd54ae9a3e5811869a9b0f7`.
- Canonical Django source appearance: `8c11edadc8debc81432d1db1145feac504f09061`.

Первоначальные 175 paths и их captures сохранены. B1/B2 изменили 5 собственных файлов и добавили 9: текущий PR содержит 184 paths. Старые журналы, screenshots и manifests сохраняют исходные timestamps/SHA/dirty-состояние и не переименовываются в результаты нового кандидата.

## Scope / deliverables

- React 19.2.8, TypeScript 5.9.3, Vite 7.3.7, React Router 7.18.4 **framework mode**, exact dependencies/package-lock; Node 24.21.0 / npm 11.19.0.
- `appDirectory: src/app`, route type generation, `ssr:false`, `prerender:[]`; public/account/staff/debug layout foundation. Anonymous index only; private prerender и production wildcard SPA fallback не добавлены.
- Shell/header/footer/navigation, оригинальные CSS/tokens/SVG/classes/cascade; без UI library, reset, новых шрифтов или редизайна.
- Approved synthetic gallery: четыре UI states, component examples, live regions, keyboard/focus/raw input retention. Debug routes и fixtures — development only.
- Четыре dispatcher slots; strict TS/runtime validation, controlled unsupported для non-string mode, missing schema, malformed/coerced descriptors, accessors/cycles/private extras. Исторические regressions сохранены.
- Generated canonical OpenAPI types:37 operations, 16 standalone DTO validators, 17 historical + 24 R02 pins. Typed transport ограничен восемью baseline identity/grade operations.
- Same-origin cookies, fresh CSRF bootstrap/header, typed safe errors, strict status/content-type/UTF8/JSON/schema boundary, AbortController/timeouts/stale-read guards. Неопределённые sent mutations не повторяются автоматически.
- §17 old-to-new mapping MS6-I01/MS7-I02/R02 dispatcher с сохранением IDs/PRs/approvals/provenance и ссылок MS7-I03/MS7-MIG-R02.

I01 предоставляет foundation. I02 владеет catalogue/content/SEO, полным published URL manifest и selective public SSG; I03 — LessonHost/widgets; I04 — account/staff и полным receipt/session/publication lifecycle. I02–I06 и backend V01–V04 здесь не реализуются; fixtures не подменяют production API.

[Migration v1.1](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/8d958aeeb17da46839722441425ccbb5889e2ab7/specs/migration/MathStart_Migration_React_FastAPI_2026-10-07_v1.1.md); [ADR-0006](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/8d958aeeb17da46839722441425ccbb5889e2ab7/docs/adr/ADR-0006-react-fastapi-migration.md); [accepted R02 handoff](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/8d958aeeb17da46839722441425ccbb5889e2ab7/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-R02/handoff.md); [active plan](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/exec-plans/active/MS7-MIG-I01.md).

## B1/B2 review corrections

**B1 — FIXED.** Logout требует HTTP200, валидного envelope и строго `data.completed === true`. `completed:false` → `INVALID_RESPONSE`, `outcome:"unknown"`, без автоматического POST, session acknowledgement или скрытого reconciliation. Полный lost-response lifecycle остаётся I04. Добавлены 12 regressions.

**B2 — FIXED.** Runner создаёт новый ignored output на каждый запуск либо принимает явно новый путь; отклоняет перезапись, historical/Git/external/unsafe paths. Реальные команды, версии, время, exit codes, SHA/dirty/fingerprint записываются отдельно; dirty code имеет `tested_implementation_sha:null`. Добавлены 12 regressions.

Руслан подтвердил исправление B1/B2 и отсутствие новых code blockers в [review5482911708](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/pull/50#pullrequestreview-5482911708). Публикационные замечания — **CLOSED** по [подтверждению Руслана](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/pull/50#issuecomment-6110165810). Итоговый UX/integration Task Approval Руслана — **PENDING**.

## Current verification — exact HEAD 150279e6

**Clean post-commit run:** `npm run verify:foundation`, 2026-10-10T13:51:18.973Z–13:52:02.003Z (16:51:18.973–16:52:02.003 МСК).

`git_before.head`, `git_after.head`, `tested_implementation_sha` = `150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55`; before/after dirty=false, source_changed_during_run=false, overall exit0.

| Проверка этого clean run | Результат |
| --- | --- |
| Versions | Node 24.21.0 / npm 11.19.0; exit0 |
| generate:api / pinned contracts | exit0;17+24 pins, 37 operations, 16 validators |
| Typecheck / check:contracts / route types | exit0 |
| Native ESM validators / Unicode / approved pack | exit0 |
| Frontend unit/component/security | **112 PASS / 0 FAIL**, 12 files |
| Historical dispatcher JS | **5 PASS / 0 FAIL** |
| Production build / graph / payload / export guards | exit0; 47 client modules, 12 artifacts |
| Dependency tree / audit | exit0;0 vulnerabilities |
| Historical integrity |84 files unchanged; before/after aggregate hashes equal |

**Отдельный raw clean post-commit отчёт:** [Полный clean post-commit JSON](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/pull/50#issuecomment-6109301800)

Raw JSON SHA-256: `2e2a5d7677bbacd2339e16296c1b71352ecb1d7546f09efd852d84f55f255149`;47,547 bytes. Полный исходный JSON опубликован отдельным техническим evidence-комментарием по ссылке выше.

Отдельно сохранены уже опубликованные **pre-commit** результаты B1/B2: [report](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/review-b1-b2-20261010/report.md), [runner JSON](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/review-b1-b2-20261010/command-results.json), [session / clean install](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/review-b1-b2-20261010/verification-session.json), [history proof](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/review-b1-b2-20261010/history-integrity.json), [manifest 13 files](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/review-b1-b2-20261010/content-manifest.json), [delta 14 paths](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/review-b1-b2-20261010/changed-files.txt). Эти журналы относятся к HEAD 79e0c19 с dirty=true/tested_implementation_sha=null; они не являются clean post-commit evidence.

`npm ci --no-fund` был выполнен перед публикацией B1/B2 (217 packages / 218 audited, exit0); в отдельном clean post-commit run он не повторялся. Существующие esbuild allowScripts advisory/Router v8 notices не скрыты; manifests/policy не изменены.

## Baseline CI

[Migration baseline verification — run38057300258](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/actions/runs/38057300258): **SUCCESS**, `head_sha=150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55`, pull_request event; завершён2026-10-10T13:55:44Z.

Это baseline CI; он **не выполняет frontend suite**. Локальные112+5 PASS не выдаются за результат CI. Frontend CI wiring (ci/generation/pins/typecheck/tests/historical/build/security/audit) остаётся handoff Руслану/R03/root-CI owner.

## Historical repository / browser evidence

Исходные результаты из [frontend log](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/frontend-commands.json), [repository log](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/repository-commands.json) и [contract/model log](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/additional-contract-commands.json) сохраняются как исторические captures:

- Frontend 88 PASS на исходной реализации — не актуальный count кандидата.
- `verify_repo.py`: 8/8 PASS в новом isolated SQLite runtime; Django 99 PASS / 8 PostgreSQL-dependent SKIP (107 run),R03 18 / Harness 73 PASS.
- Отдельные R02A 30 / R03A 41 / UI 7 и migration R02 63 PASS — model/synthetic evidence, не target implementation/concurrency/recovery.
- Python 3.14.7 локально; baseline CI использует 3.12. PostgreSQL/Docker условия тогда отсутствовали; SQLite не доказывает PostgreSQL locking.

Эти Python/DB/browser suites не перезапускались для B1/B2. Working PostgreSQL/R01 DB не изменялись.

[Screenshot index](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/screenshot-index.md), [metadata/hashes](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/screenshot-index.json), [keyboard/CSS evidence](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/browser-evidence.json):10 final + 23 checkpoint screenshots, всего 33. Chromium 155.0.8059.27 из UA Client Hints, отдельная IAB version unconfirmed.

Три live fresh task-local Django SQLite gallery / React JPEGpairs byte-identical на 360×800 / 768×1024 / 1440×1000. Geometry/CSS/leaf text, keyboard/skip/retry/field-error focus/raw retention, pointer activation, отсутствие overflow/root CSS isolation проверены. Это gallery+shell comparison, **не R01 PostgreSQL/live full-site parity**; source-derived captures не переименованы.

## Security / rollback / handoffs

Ни Django application/authored lesson HTML/CSS/JS/models/migrations/root dependencies/workflows, ни frozen API/domain contracts не менялись. Все 84 historical capture blobs сохранены. Primary checkout/working DB/R01 baseline не использовались для записи.

Initial 175 paths и B1/B2 delta 14 прошли scoped privacy/security review; реальные secrets/credentials/PII не выявлены. `.env`, node_modules, build/cache/runtime/DB/dumps/cookies/browser profiles в Git не включены. Production guards исключают debug fixtures/routes/reference/private payloads/credential canaries/private HTML/source maps. Adapter пока tree-shaken из пустых routes; mock tests не являются live target API proof.

Rollback — revert scoped foundation/fix commits через review; DB rollback не требуется.

- Manual hover — **PENDING / NOT_RUN**; pointer activation его не заменяет.
- Local preview404 не доказывает production gateway404/method/CSRF/cache/redirect parity; требуется deployment evidence V05.
- Target API/account/staff/session/receipt/P1/P2/recovery/concurrency/cutover не реализованы полностью и не проверены.
- **F01–F04 unchanged:** 13baybars, исправления не позже I03, обязательная проверка I05 до UI/content freeze.
- F04: на 360×800 при обычном масштабе SVG labels читаемы без clipping/overlap, сохранены angles/coordinates/text readout/controls/math; regression 768/1440. Новых pixel/font thresholds нет; независимая math/content проверка возможна Владимиром.
- Frontend CI — Руслан/R03, **PENDING**. Независимый API/security review/approval Владимира — **APPROVED** на exact HEAD `150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55`: [review](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/pull/50#pullrequestreview-5483318464).

## Evidence / human gate

[Original acceptance matrix](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/requirements-matrix.md), [§17 original→target index](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/old-to-new-evidence.json), [original final report](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/report.md), [original175 paths](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/changed-files.txt), [original hashes](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/79e0c19c234e36381662cbbf57e5b042727b1a61/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-I01/final/content-manifest.json), [trace](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/150279e6ca7f1c82a6f23d8899e50992cf358f55/docs/agent-traces/MS7-MIG-I01.md).

Эти original records привязаны к исходной реализации; актуальный delta и clean post-commit proof выделены выше, история не переписана.

**Reviewers / Task Approvers:** Руслан (`Tramsey00`) — UX/integration; Владимир (`VladimirFrolov777`) — API/security. Owner не утверждает собственный результат.

pr.body:
MS7-MIG-V01 — SQLAlchemy models, Alembic and upgrade profiles

Task / ownership

  • Task: MS7-MIG-V01

  • Issue: Refs #34

  • Owner: Владимир

  • Reviewer / Task Approver: Руслан

  • Target branch: ms7-mig-react-fastapi

  • Source branch: ms7-mig-v01-schema

  • Milestone gate: MIG-G1

Exact SHA references

Reference | SHA -- | -- Current published PR HEAD | 393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e Reviewed implementation HEAD | 1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4 Accepted integration input | 8d958aeeb17da46839722441425ccbb5889e2ab7 Immutable MIG_BASE_SHA | 60b341fbd00f4c8dadd54ae9a3e5811869a9b0f7

The previous uncertainty about baseline CI coverage of the evidence-only PR HEAD is therefore closed.

For historical reference, run 38054413732 also reported SUCCESS on the earlier implementation HEAD:

1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4

The current-head baseline run is the relevant confirmed result for this PR candidate.

Important: baseline CI validates the historical Django/repository verification environment. It does not execute the dedicated target SQLAlchemy/Alembic PostgreSQL suite and cannot replace target V01 verification.

Target SQLAlchemy/Alembic PostgreSQL CI — PENDING

The dedicated target CI remains an open mandatory acceptance requirement.

R03 target CI handoff v5

Required verification includes:

  • Separate locked SQLAlchemy/Alembic test environment.

  • Disposable PostgreSQL 16.

  • All 34 V01 target tests.

  • All 23 PostgreSQL cases without skips.

  • Fresh install twice on disposable databases.

  • Upgrade profiles A/B/C.

  • Constraints, defaults, sequences and schema drift checks.

  • Unknown/invalid Alembic migration-head rejection.

  • Rollback and failure-injection negatives.

  • B01, CHECK and F1–F3 regression coverage.

  • Accurate PASS/FAIL/SKIP counts and nonzero exit codes on failure.

  • Evidence tied to the exact applicable PR candidate SHA.

The target suite has passed in the documented local environment, but target GitHub CI has not yet been confirmed on the current PR candidate.

Root CI/R03 ownership remains with Ruslan. V01 does not modify shared workflows independently.

Remaining CI action

Integrate and execute the dedicated R03 target PostgreSQL verification job against the applicable V01 candidate, using the published handoff.

Successful baseline CI alone is insufficient for V01 Task Approval.

Nonblocking follow-up

P3 — Legacy verification helper evidence output

The independent CI-remediation review identified that backend/tests/legacy_ci_verification.py writes to a fixed evidence-output path and may overwrite its existing v4 result on repeated execution.

This is a nonblocking evidence-reproducibility concern. It remains recorded for a scoped follow-up.

Historical reports and acceptance evidence must not be silently rewritten.

Outstanding limitations

  • Legacy baseline CI on current PR HEAD: SUCCESS / VERIFIED by Ruslan.

  • Publication manifest, §17 index and independent-review provenance: OWNER REVIEW FINDINGS CLOSED.

  • Target SQLAlchemy/Alembic GitHub CI: PENDING.

  • Independent human Task Approval by Ruslan: PENDING.

  • Production/cutover verification: NOT VERIFIED.

  • Deployed database variants: NOT VERIFIED.

  • Full lifecycle/load and post-commit acknowledgement-loss scenarios: NOT VERIFIED, subject to downstream task scope.

  • Nonblocking P3 evidence-output reproducibility follow-up: OPEN / NONBLOCKING.

Historical local PASS results and prior technical reviews remain attributed to their actual execution scopes.

Current acceptance status

MS7-MIG-V01 — INCOMPLETE / AWAITING TARGET POSTGRESQL CI AND INDEPENDENT TASK APPROVAL.

The backend implementation, B01 compatibility clarification, publication manifest, current §17 index and independent technical-review evidence have been published.

Ruslan's latest owner re-review confirms that all three previous publication/evidence findings are resolved and that current-head baseline CI is successful.

Remaining mandatory gates:

  1. Dedicated target PostgreSQL CI on the applicable candidate: 34 tests, including 23 PostgreSQL cases without skips, fresh twice and upgrade A/B/C.

  2. Independent human Task Approval by Ruslan on the accepted exact candidate.

Final Task Approval and integration merge remain separate owner-controlled steps.

No production migration, release approval, integration merge or completed human acceptance is claimed.

# MS7-MIG-V01 — SQLAlchemy models, Alembic and upgrade profiles ## Task / ownership - **Task:** MS7-MIG-V01 - **Issue:** Refs #34 - **Owner:** Владимир - **Reviewer / Task Approver:** Руслан - **Target branch:** `ms7-mig-react-fastapi` - **Source branch:** `ms7-mig-v01-schema` - **Milestone gate:** MIG-G1 ### Exact SHA references | Reference | SHA | |---|---| | Current published PR HEAD | `393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e` | | Reviewed implementation HEAD | `1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4` | | Accepted integration input | `8d958aeeb17da46839722441425ccbb5889e2ab7` | | Immutable MIG_BASE_SHA | `60b341fbd00f4c8dadd54ae9a3e5811869a9b0f7` | The current PR HEAD includes an additional evidence-only commit. The backend implementation reviewed by Ruslan remains anchored to `1f97d762...`. Ruslan subsequently re-reviewed publication and acceptance evidence on current PR HEAD `393d988...`, confirming closure of the three previous evidence findings and successful baseline CI. Target PostgreSQL CI and independent human Task Approval remain pending. ## Goal Implement the MS7-MIG-V01 PostgreSQL persistence foundation using SQLAlchemy 2 and Alembic, while preserving the accepted Django baseline, existing data, IDs, constraints, migration history and frozen API/domain contracts. This task provides the schema and migration foundation for subsequent FastAPI migration tasks V02–V04. ## Implementation scope Implemented: - SQLAlchemy metadata covering 20 baseline tables and seven migration protocol records. - Alembic revision chain `v01_0001 → v01_0002`. - Fresh PostgreSQL schema creation without Django runtime. - Reviewed upgrade profiles A/B/C. - Guarded schema proof, migration-head validation and drift detection. - Preservation of existing users, profiles, grades, permissions, foreign keys, constraints, indexes, sequences and applied Django migration history. - Grade epoch compatibility and idempotent backfill. - Repository/Unit of Work infrastructure, transaction boundaries and ordered collector locks. - Explicit PostgreSQL configuration without silent SQLite fallback. - Positive, negative, concurrency and rollback regression tests. Historical Django migrations and accepted frozen R02 artifacts remain unchanged. ### Out of scope - FastAPI Content and Grades routes (V02). - Identity/session/receipt service implementation (V03). - Publication service runtime (V04). - Frontend/React implementation. - Production migrations or deployment. - Independent changes to root CI workflows owned by Ruslan/R03. ## Resolved implementation findings ### B01 — PostgreSQL BIGINT compatibility Ruslan, acting as R02 Owner, approved a narrowly scoped compatibility clarification. The following three primary-key columns use the confirmed physical PostgreSQL baseline type `BIGINT`: - `auth_group_permissions.id` - `auth_user_groups.id` - `auth_user_user_permissions.id` Related `user_id`, `group_id` and `permission_id` types remain unchanged. Existing ID values, FK relationships, constraints and identity/sequence semantics are preserved. The accepted R02 files, bytes and digests were not rewritten. [[Versioned B01 compatibility addendum](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/compatibility-addendum-v1.0.0.md)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/compatibility-addendum-v1.0.0.md) ### CHECK canonicalization The upgrade-profile-A CHECK comparison issue was corrected without weakening schema drift detection. Actual incompatible CHECK definitions continue to be rejected. ### F1 — Django timestamp parity Restored Django-compatible timestamp behavior for ordinary writes, preserving a separate explicit path for historical imports. ### F2 — PostgreSQL collector concurrency Corrected lock planning for CASCADE, SET_NULL and related dependencies. Malformed or unknown migration states fail closed rather than being silently accepted. ### CI integration remediation Separated legacy Django unittest discovery from explicit SQLAlchemy/Alembic target suites. The legacy environment does not require target-only SQLAlchemy dependencies. Target suites continue to run explicitly in their own locked environment. The existing root CI workflows were not modified by V01. ## Verification evidence ### Local implementation checks The implementation and remediation reports record: | Check | Result | |---|---| | Target SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL suite | 34 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 SKIP | | Target PostgreSQL cases within suite | 23 exercised without skips | | Fresh install twice | PASS locally | | Upgrade profiles A/B/C | PASS locally | | Target runtime CLI without Django | 10/10 PASS | | Canonical repository verification | 8/8 PASS locally | | R02 migration contract suite | 63/63 PASS | | Frozen R02A/R03A suites | 30/30 and 41/41 PASS | | B01, CHECK, F1/F2/F3 regressions | PASS locally | | Frozen contract digest verification | PASS | These results are tied to their documented local execution environments and source snapshots. They are not presented as target GitHub CI results for the current PR HEAD. [[Implementation report v4](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/implementation-report-v4.md)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/implementation-report-v4.md) ## Independent technical review provenance The original negative findings and later positive technical reviews are preserved as separate evidence. Their scopes and checked states must not be conflated. **1. Original independent audit — NOT READY** Identified three P2 findings: F1, F2 and F3. The audit reviewed accepted input `8d958ae...` plus 53 untracked implementation files. Its original failures were retained. [[Original independent audit](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-audit-v3/MS7-MIG-V01-INDEPENDENT-AUDIT-REPORT.md)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-audit-v3/MS7-MIG-V01-INDEPENDENT-AUDIT-REPORT.md) **2. Developer remediation — F1/F2/F3 FIXED locally** Implementation changes and regression evidence addressed all three findings while preserving B01 and CHECK compatibility. **3. Positive independent technical re-audit — READY for publication preparation** A later independent audit examined accepted input `8d958ae...` plus 71 untracked files, checked the target suite and reproduced the two-order F2 concurrency scenarios. Its result supported preparing V01 for publication. It did not constitute exact-current-PR-SHA review or human Task Approval. [[Positive technical re-audit](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-reviews-v5/final-f1-f2-f3/MS7-MIG-V01-FINAL-INDEPENDENT-AUDIT.md)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-reviews-v5/final-f1-f2-f3/MS7-MIG-V01-FINAL-INDEPENDENT-AUDIT.md) **4. Independent CI remediation review — READY within CI-fix scope** A separate technical review assessed the Django test-discovery remediation after `d5dc9...`, with its actual changed-file scope. It did not independently rerun the complete PostgreSQL target suite. One nonblocking P3 concerning evidence-output reproducibility was recorded. [[CI remediation review evidence](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-reviews-v5/ci-remediation-review-transcript.md)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-reviews-v5/ci-remediation-review-transcript.md) [[Complete independent review provenance](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-review-provenance-v5.json)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/independent-review-provenance-v5.json) None of these technical audits is represented as a completed independent human Task Approval by Ruslan. ## Owner review and evidence remediation Ruslan initially reviewed implementation HEAD: `1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4` He confirmed the presence of B01, CHECK and F1–F3 fixes without identifying new blocking implementation defects. Acceptance remained pending due to publication evidence consistency, §17 index completeness, independent review provenance and target CI. The documentation corrections were published in the evidence-only commit: `393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e` Ruslan subsequently performed an independent owner re-review on that exact published HEAD. **Owner re-review result: all three previous publication/evidence findings CLOSED.** He confirmed: - Exact Git blob SHA256, object IDs and sizes match for all 86 publication-manifest entries. - Historical manifests remain unchanged. - All 36 original LF/CRLF differences are explained and preserved in the comparison evidence. - The updated §17 index includes the required fields, correct links and separate implementation/input/baseline SHA references. - Historical results and approvals remain unchanged. - The positive independent technical re-audit has been published with verifiable artifacts. - The original negative audit, positive re-audit and CI-remediation review have correctly separated provenance and verification scopes. - Technical READY is not represented as human Task Approval. - Backend, Alembic, frozen R02 and historical artifacts were not modified by the evidence commit. - No new blocking defects were identified during this re-review. This closes the owner's three evidence-publication findings but does **not** close the separate target CI or final human Task Approval requirements. ### Publication manifest [[Publication manifest v1](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/publication-manifest-v1.json)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/publication-manifest-v1.json) - 86/86 exact implementation Git blobs verified. - SHA256, Git object IDs and blob sizes independently matched by Ruslan. - Published SHA256 values are calculated from Git blob content bytes, not Windows checkout files. - LF/CRLF policy is explicit. - Historical manifests were preserved without rewriting. [[Historical publication comparison](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/publication-comparison-v1.json)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/publication-comparison-v1.json) The original 36 checkout-versus-blob digest mismatches remain recorded. Their LF/CRLF causes have been confirmed rather than hidden. ### Current §17 old-to-new evidence index [[Old-to-new evidence index v4](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/old-to-new-evidence-v4.json)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/old-to-new-evidence-v4.json) Includes: - `platform_disposition` - `current_status` - Separate accepted input, implementation and baseline SHA references - Current implementation and verification evidence - Legacy CI and pending target CI status - Historical source-to-migration evidence links Ruslan confirmed the mandatory fields, links and SHA distinctions. Historical approvals, source results and earlier indices remain preserved. ## GitHub CI ### Legacy baseline CI — SUCCESS on current PR HEAD **Current published PR HEAD:** `393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e` **Verified GitHub Actions run:** [[Run 38137695565 — Migration baseline verification](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/actions/runs/38137695565)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/actions/runs/38137695565) **Result: SUCCESS** Ruslan independently confirmed the successful current-head baseline run. The run passed: | Check | Result | |---|---| | Legacy Django test suite | 109 PASS | | R03 contract suite | 18 PASS | | Harness test suite | 73 PASS | | R02A contract suite | 30 PASS | | R03A contract suite | 41 PASS | | Canonical `verify_repo` | 8/8 PASS | The previous uncertainty about baseline CI coverage of the evidence-only PR HEAD is therefore closed. For historical reference, [[run 38054413732](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/actions/runs/38054413732)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/actions/runs/38054413732) also reported SUCCESS on the earlier implementation HEAD: `1f97d762c4089efb2e4ef6d8c7ebe0bdcbe161f4` The current-head baseline run is the relevant confirmed result for this PR candidate. **Important:** baseline CI validates the historical Django/repository verification environment. It does not execute the dedicated target SQLAlchemy/Alembic PostgreSQL suite and cannot replace target V01 verification. ### Target SQLAlchemy/Alembic PostgreSQL CI — PENDING The dedicated target CI remains an open mandatory acceptance requirement. [[R03 target CI handoff v5](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/r03-ci-handoff-v5.md)](https://github.com/Tramsey00/MathStart-Python/blob/393d98890649c6c7c47908424ba0d076b5b5e56e/docs/acceptance/MS7-MIG-V01/r03-ci-handoff-v5.md) Required verification includes: - Separate locked SQLAlchemy/Alembic test environment. - Disposable PostgreSQL 16. - All **34 V01 target tests**. - All **23 PostgreSQL cases without skips**. - Fresh install twice on disposable databases. - Upgrade profiles A/B/C. - Constraints, defaults, sequences and schema drift checks. - Unknown/invalid Alembic migration-head rejection. - Rollback and failure-injection negatives. - B01, CHECK and F1–F3 regression coverage. - Accurate PASS/FAIL/SKIP counts and nonzero exit codes on failure. - Evidence tied to the exact applicable PR candidate SHA. The target suite has passed in the documented local environment, but **target GitHub CI has not yet been confirmed on the current PR candidate**. Root CI/R03 ownership remains with Ruslan. V01 does not modify shared workflows independently. ### Remaining CI action Integrate and execute the dedicated R03 target PostgreSQL verification job against the applicable V01 candidate, using the published handoff. Successful baseline CI alone is insufficient for V01 Task Approval. ## Nonblocking follow-up **P3 — Legacy verification helper evidence output** The independent CI-remediation review identified that `backend/tests/legacy_ci_verification.py` writes to a fixed evidence-output path and may overwrite its existing v4 result on repeated execution. This is a nonblocking evidence-reproducibility concern. It remains recorded for a scoped follow-up. Historical reports and acceptance evidence must not be silently rewritten. ## Outstanding limitations - Legacy baseline CI on current PR HEAD: **SUCCESS / VERIFIED by Ruslan**. - Publication manifest, §17 index and independent-review provenance: **OWNER REVIEW FINDINGS CLOSED**. - Target SQLAlchemy/Alembic GitHub CI: **PENDING**. - Independent human Task Approval by Ruslan: **PENDING**. - Production/cutover verification: **NOT VERIFIED**. - Deployed database variants: **NOT VERIFIED**. - Full lifecycle/load and post-commit acknowledgement-loss scenarios: **NOT VERIFIED**, subject to downstream task scope. - Nonblocking P3 evidence-output reproducibility follow-up: **OPEN / NONBLOCKING**. Historical local PASS results and prior technical reviews remain attributed to their actual execution scopes. ## Current acceptance status **MS7-MIG-V01 — INCOMPLETE / AWAITING TARGET POSTGRESQL CI AND INDEPENDENT TASK APPROVAL.** The backend implementation, B01 compatibility clarification, publication manifest, current §17 index and independent technical-review evidence have been published.
